name: After § 87
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the European Public Prosecutor’s Office for the financial year 2023
part_text: 87 b. Notes that, in two cases out of three, the EPPO does not open an investigation in response to a report; calls on the EPPO to include elected opposition members of the European Parliament to observe the internal decision process to open or dismiss investigations as well a to monitor unusual delays in investigations;
